svg.title: British Columbia Forest Service raccoon advertisement: reconstruction
svg.desc: Reconstructed from Gulf Islands Driftwood, 2 December 1971, page 11. Supplied photograph placed unchanged, PofBC emblem geometry retained with newspaper paint treatment, editable font-based lettering or matching glyph outlines. Likely Futura-family oblique in the original; this reconstruction uses a named static derivative of Jost Italic weight 600, not an authenticated original font.

svg.aria-label: PofBC Forest Service emblem, newspaper paint treatment
svg.title: British Columbia Forest Service newspaper treatment from PofBC master
svg.desc: Newspaper paint treatment of the existing PofBC colour-master geometry. Original badge, province, three islands, crown and trunk coordinates retained unchanged. Added black print ground; badge white keyline; outlined province; white islands and evergreen. Reference: Gulf Islands Driftwood, 2 December 1971, page 11. This is a reconstruction, not an official historic master.
